prompts.text: Reproduce this merged ADO PR as a disposable draft and run Buddies before publishing its findings.
Create cumulative evaluation PRs at successive commits so we can find when the default Roundtable reviewers first detect the regression.
Automate the exact-diff evaluation PR workflow we used for the known finding.
Use this Azure DevOps squash merge commit to recover its original PR diff and create an evaluation draft.
Evaluate everything from base commit aaa111 through source commit bbb222 and publish it in a disposable draft PR.
Review this active ADO PR with Roundtable and tell me what to fix.
Commit my current changes, push the branch, and open a normal pull request.
Compare these two saved Buddies reports without creating or publishing anything.
Rewrite the Buddies Judge prompt so it handles conflicting findings better.
